de1.P2.C1.ly_do: Da xem truc tiep do thi f' image9.png trong cay de: f' tiep xuc truc hoanh tai x=-2 (nghiem kep, khong doi dau), f'(-1)=-2, f' doi dau tai x=1; suy ra f'(x)=(x+2)^2(x-1): a Sai (f' am tren (-vo cuc;-2) nen f nghich bien), b Sai (chi doi dau qua x=1 nen 1 cuc tri), c Sai (f'(2)=16 khac 4), d Dung (g'(x)=(x-1)(x+1)(x+3) > 0 tren (-5/2;-3/2)). tf_ans luu (Sai,Sai,Sai,Dung) da dung.

de1.P2.C2.ly_do: Da xem truc tiep do thi image12.png trong cay de: do thi phang o muc 2 voi |x| >= 2, lom xuong cuc tieu -2 tai x=0, co diem gay tai x=+-2 noi doan hang; a Dung (khong co dao ham tai diem gay +-2), b Sai (chi co 1 cuc tri tai x=0 theo loi giai goc), c Dung (nho nhat -2 tai 0), d Sai (co gia tri lon nhat 2). tf_ans luu (Dung,Sai,Dung,Sai) da dung.
